description: Great Expectations static threshold baseline suite for daily quality metrics in Phase II monitoring.

thresholds.rationale: Daily hourly intervals; batches with fewer than 20 rows indicate significant data pipeline ingestion loss.
Maximum tolerable missing temperature cell rate is 1.0% (SLA threshold), based on zero historical defects in Phase I baseline.
Phase I baseline 3-sigma range [77.186, 208.683] derived objectively from 2011 baseline without inspecting Phase II drift.
